title: The problem card: the family, the label situation, the questions that block, and a build only from a ready card
request: Make DCLab understand the problem before building: the owner's anomaly-detection test was built into a model of customer ids while the labels question was open.
spec: ProblemCard v1 in dclab_core: the brief, the family with the families still in play, the label situation, the outcome, the questions marked blocking or not, and readiness with reasons; on Home, a project is built only from a ready card. Done when the morning's sentence leaves rare events and anomalies in play with a blocking labels question, and the build is refused with that reason until it is answered.
plan: Build on the brief: the card adds what the brief cannot say alone (family, label situation, readiness).
Rules in code with their reasons; precedence: a stated kind, the label situation, a stated task, then the words.
Read the draft's card from its words, answers, saved solution, sample suggestion and files.
Refuse the build while the card blocks; say plainly what DCLab cannot build yet.
Map the card onto the main product's ProblemSpec and decision points.

decisions.decision: The morning's sentence leaves two families in play rather than choosing anomaly.
decisions.why: The same words fit rare events with labels and anomalies without; only the label situation tells them apart, so it is asked.

decisions.decision: The unit and the action are asked but never block a build.
decisions.why: Home has no unit question and the brief rarely knows it; blocking on it would refuse almost every build. Passed to the conversation (20.2).

decisions.decision: With a table, an outcome is a column or a joined file of known cases; never a sentence or a file only mentioned.
decisions.why: 'It is anomaly detection', typed when asked the outcome, and 'a file lists the known ones' with no file both made a card ready with no outcome.

decisions.decision: A ready anomaly card is refused with a plain message naming what DCLab does solve.
decisions.why: Anomaly detection without labels is not in the engine (20.7); building it as something else is the morning's failure.

decisions.decision: What the person said beats a matching word.
decisions.why: 'market segment' made a churn problem segmentation; 'default settings' made it rare events.

change: dclab_core/card.py (new), dclab_core/contracts.py, schemas and baseline, dclab_core/adapters/main_product.py (problem_card), CHANGELOG and version 0.6.0, CORE_INTEGRATION.md, scripts/core_wheel_check.py; dclab_rnd/draft/card.py (new), draft/api.py (card route, readiness, BuildRefused.rule, the card kept with the project), draft/chat.py (the labels question in any pack, with 'Nothing is labelled'); tests/test_problem_card.py (new), test_morning_guard.py; the web client.

findings.defect: A sentence typed as the outcome made the outcome known.
findings.scenario: 'it is anomaly detection' was taken as the outcome's definition.
findings.cause: Any answer to the outcome question was an outcome.
findings.fix: With a table, only a column or a joined file is an outcome.

findings.defect: A ready anomaly card would be built as something it is not.
findings.scenario: No engine for anomalies without labels.
findings.fix: Refused with a plain message and the route DCLab solves.

findings.defect: My fault-planting script restored the wrong file over the library card.
findings.scenario: Two files named card.py shared one backup name; the restore wrote the studio's card over dclab_core's; tests skipped and the product flows failed.
findings.cause: Backups named by base name only.
findings.fix: Rebuilt from an earlier backup and the review's edits; backups now named by full path; the flows and tests rerun.

findings.defect: Words alone invented an outcome and a project was built with neither outcome nor labels.
findings.scenario: 'A file lists the known ones' with no file attached: ready, built.
findings.cause: A file spoken of set the outcome.
findings.fix: Only a joined file sets it; a file spoken of asks for it.

findings.defect: Family words overrode what the person stated.
findings.scenario: 'market segment' made a churn problem segmentation, ready with no moment and no outcome.
findings.cause: Words were tried before the task.
findings.fix: A stated kind, then a stated task, before words; segmentation only with no outcome.

findings.scenario: 'Rank customers by risk' was ranking; 'default settings' rare events; 'lifetime value' time to event; 'incremental loads' uplift.
findings.fix: Patterns need their objects (rank items, default on a loan, incremental lift).

findings.defect: The blocking labels question was often never asked, and a plain no was misread.
findings.scenario: Outside the fraud pack it was never asked; 'No' read as partial labels, looping on a file the person did not have.
findings.cause: The question belonged to one pack; the answer parser was narrow.
findings.fix: Asked in any pack right after the outcome when two families are in play; the card's own words read the answer, a no first.

findings.defect: Drafts without data skipped the card.
findings.scenario: A plan-only project built while the labels question was open.
findings.fix: A plan-only draft is refused while its family is open; every project keeps its card.

findings.defect: No mapping for the main product, only prose.
findings.scenario: Its ProblemSpec lost the family and readiness.

findings.defect: The frozen v1 lacked families the plan lists.
findings.scenario: Entity tables, streams, text or images would force a v2.
findings.fix: Added now, named by a host.
Rebuilt; the route tested with a 404.

findings.defect: The record named the wrong refusal rule for anomalies.
findings.scenario: rule 'list of known cases' for the anomaly refusal.
findings.cause: The rule was guessed from the message.

measurements.name: planted faults
measurements.gate: each of the 9 planted faults in the card and Home fails a test
measurements.result: 9 of 9 caught after adding 2 tests for faults first uncaught (words beating the person, a chosen kind ignored)

measurements.name: product flows
measurements.gate: the four end-to-end flows pass with the readiness rule on
limits: The browser test of the wizard was not run on this machine.

outcome: A project is built only from a ready card; the morning's sentence asks about confirmed cases, and an anomaly search without labels is said plainly, not built as something else.
lessons: When the same words fit two families, ask the question that tells them apart.
What a person stated outranks any word that happens to match.
An outcome must be something the table or its files hold, not something said.
Back up by full path: two files with one name will overwrite each other.
Plant each new rule's fault; a passing test may be passing for another rule's sake.
risks: A model built on a guessed outcome.
A family chosen by a stray word.
A question that blocks and is never asked.
A backup restoring the wrong file.
